articles.title: Idaho family has farmed 1,000 acres since 1950; after the state largely shut off its irrigation water in 2025, the owners say crops failed and are now suing to protect the family farm
articles.summary: An Idaho family that has farmed 1,000 acres along the Snake River since 1950 is suing the state after an emergency order shut off their irrigation water in 2025. The owners state that the abrupt halt, caused by dwindling water levels, has resulted in failed crops and jeopardized their livelihood. The legal action seeks to protect the family farm from the impacts of the state’s decision to cease irrigation.
